title: Did anyone else realize the projector died?
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text: The Yellow Brick Board · town hall · June 2026
Did anyone else realize the projector died ten minutes into the budget presentation?

Oscar Diggs ran the whole thing from behind the stage curtain with a flashlight and a flip chart. Nobody in the room knew until he took a bow. I took the reading room's copy of the draft budget along afterwards, for anyone who wants to read the figures at their own pace.
The flip chart was the backup. Always bring the backup.
I was the one at the back asking why the budget had no line for the ward repair fund. The office said it would publish the full numbers. We'll see.
Good question. Nobody else asked it.
